ItemID: NA; Title: Karmacode; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic heaviness interests me, but other albums here fit my current mood more closely.
ItemID: NA; Title: Saturday Night Wrist; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Atmospheric heavy rock appeals to me after spending time with Tool and heavier melodic albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Us and Them; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic hard rock fits my interest in The Reason and One Day Remains.
ItemID: NA; Title: Falling Away; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot confidently place this title, so it does not give me enough reason to choose it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nightmare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metal direction appeals, but I would prioritize a few closer matches this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Oncoming Storm; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its aggressive riffs fit the heavier mood suggested by Advance And Vanquish and my In Flames listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Train Of Thought; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Heavy progressive metal feels especially appealing after 10.000 Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: Glorious Burden; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The metal sound interests me, but I am less drawn to its theatrical approach right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Someone In Control; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its direct, heavy rock sound fits my recent interest in Ten Thousand Fists and Scars.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, abrasive sound is less appealing today than the melodic hooks and layered heaviness I want.
